description: Authored examples for reviewer discussion; no games were generated, played or judged automatically.

cases.observation: From ground the player rises, descends, lands on a raised platform, then repeats a controlled jump.

expected.reason: A full observed motion/landing sequence, not one still.

cases.observation: Jump key changes the sprite pose, but the player never leaves the ground.

expected.reason: Pose change alone is not a jump.

cases.observation: The same coin position increments the count on every revisit without restarting.

expected.reason: Pickup must occur once per coin per round.

cases.observation: No coin was reached within the six-session budget.

expected.reason: Unobserved is not an invented defect or a pass.

cases.observation: A victory banner appears on starting, before traversing the level.
Restart hides the failure overlay but leaves a nonzero coin count and missing pickups.

expected.reason: Overlay removal alone is not a reset.

cases.observation: Browser input transport disconnected before movement could be tested.

expected.reason: Do not score tool failure as a gameplay defect.
